Container.Name: bambu-p2s-bridge
Container.Overview: Remote monitoring and control for a Bambu Lab P2S in LAN mode: live camera, start/pause, temperatures and AMS, automatic part ejection, print queue, MakerWorld import, slicing on the server. No vendor cloud. After starting, open the WebUI and follow the setup wizard (pick the printer, enter the access code, scan the QR code on your phone).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, print history, MakerWorld login and the downloaded slicer live here.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app and API (host network).

Config.Name: Embedded go2rtc
Config.Description: Run the camera relay inside this container (ports 11984/18554 on localhost, 18555 for WebRTC). Leave at 1.
